FAQ

Questions realtors and real estate pros ask

Can I accept a referral commission on investor loans?

Rules depend on your state, your brokerage and the type of loan. Real estate investor loans are business-purpose loans on non-owner-occupied property, but you should confirm with your managing broker or attorney before accepting commissions.

Do you finance primary residences?

No. Real estate investor loans are for investment properties only. We don’t offer residential mortgages for an owner’s primary home.

Do my investors need experience?

No. First-time flippers are welcome. Investors need a 660+ credit score and a loan amount over $100K.

Do I need lending experience?

No. You make the introduction. Our in-house funding team handles the calls, documents, underwriting and closing.

What does it cost to join?

We cover membership options on your demo call, once we understand your network and goals.
